title: Machine snapshot encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $w$ be a finite Boolean input string, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. The snapshot encoding at time $t$ is the encoding of the machine snapshot at that time, with the Boolean indicator of whether the tableau is accepted appended.
hypotheses_covered: A deterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
caveat: The snippet does not define the snapshot, its encoding, or the tableau acceptance indicator.
